new_spots.name: Sheepdog Statue
new_spots.photo_reason: Current colour photo of the bronze collie on its stone plinth with lake and mountains behind; right place (Tekapo, matches Wikipedia section), shows the named thing, wide enough, real photograph. Sourced by Wikipedia's Sheepdog statue section and Wikivoyage's Church of the Good Shepherd entry.

new_spots.name: Mount John Walkway
new_spots.photo_reason: Shows a DOC signboard (with an Astro Cafe ad) and a gravel path under larch trees at the trailhead: fails check 2/3 (a sign and a path, not a view of the walk's payoff) and the no-signage rule. Find a summit or lake-view photo. NOTE: ticketUrl can be set: Wikivoyage lists https://www.doc.govt.nz/parks-and-recreation/places-to-go/canterbury/places/lake-tekapo-area/things-to-do/lake-tekapo-town-tracks/ and it loads (200, title 'Mt John Walkway: Lake Tekapo area'); the proposal's left-null is out of date. Trailhead coords match Tekapo Springs, OK.

new_spots.name: Lake Tekapo Regional Park
new_spots.photo_reason: No photo proposed. ticketUrl is the ECan URL cited by Wikipedia as the managing agency page; my fetch hit a bot wall (Incapsula), so I could not confirm the title independently, only the proposal's claim. Wikipedia lists it under Tekapo attractions; 165 ha, 24 km tracks, access from town. Centroid ~2.5 km east of town, fine for a park.

new_spots.name: Lake Alexandrina
new_spots.objection: Only source is its own Wikipedia stub (fishing and wildlife refuge, 'a delight to a fisherman'); no Wikivoyage, guidebook or agency entry names it as a place to go (Wikivoyage Tekapo has no mention) and it is an angler/bach lake used by locals. The proposal itself flags it marginal. Fails 'rarely visited / only locals use'.

new_spots.name: Burkes Pass
new_spots.objection: Marginal but passes the forgiving bar: a village on SH8 into the Mackenzie with a cafe, antiques and a Burke memorial, with its own Wikipedia article. Correction: the proposal cites a Wikivoyage Burkes Pass article, which does not exist, and Wikivoyage Tekapo does not mention it, so Wikipedia is the only source. It is about 21 km by road, 17 km straight line (within span).
new_spots.photo_reason: A main road dominates the frame with a roadside cafe and shops behind and parked vans: an ordinary street scene, fails check 3 (spectacular and wide) and 2 (not the pass or a recognisable attraction). Either find a pass/landscape or memorial photo, or ship none.

existing_fixes.reason: Current bio overlaps lake-tekapo-2 by naming the Mount John stargazing tours; reframing around the lakefront centre (1 Motuariki Lane) keeps it a distinct place without removing it. Keep the spot and its ticketUrl; do not delete.
Mount John University Observatory is the official, correct name; the proposal itself says no change required. Leave as is.
